conventions.curves: A curve is {"dense": [v, ...]} with one value per difficulty from 1, or {"keyframes": [[difficulty, value], ...]} stating only the points the data gives. Values between keyframes are not interpolated here.
conventions.media: A media handle carries a stable id and the source dimensions, never a path. Map the id onto wherever you serve art from.
conventions.non_finite_numbers: JSON cannot express NaN or infinity, so they appear as the strings "NaN", "Infinity", and "-Infinity".
conventions.null: The record does not carry this value. It is never a stand-in for zero, for an empty string, or for a value that exists but was not recovered.
conventions.order: Records are stable-sorted and object keys are in declaration order, the same order every other delivery states its fields in, so a data refresh diffs one entity at a time.

delivery: This folder is one of this repository's deliveries of the same dataset, for consumers that would rather read JSON than install a package.
